Kimberly / Dylan —

I pulled the account dump and ran it against our duplicate detection heuristics. Quick findings: 
- The three accounts you listed (platform-admin, team-ml, team-ingest) are tied to the same billing domain and have overlapping IP provisioning patterns over the last 10 days.
- We also surfaced two additional accounts (cf-test-01@cloudforge.com, cf-proof@cloudforge.com) that requested fresh trials between 6/18 and 6/30 and appear to be on the same corporate credit card token.
- Token usage shows a sharp spike consistent with concurrent multi-account experiments (sustained high-QPS).

Recommendation: treat this as trial-chaining under policy section 3.2.1. Revoke the two most recent trial top-ups (cf-test-01, cf-proof) and place a hold on automated credits for any new accounts from the cloudforge.com domain until CloudForge confirms their consolidated billing contact. Also recommend limiting future top-ups to a single consolidated allocation per billing domain and documenting the mutual action plan.

I attached short notes (fraud_notes_kp_rm.txt) with the account ids and the confidence score. If Sales wants to preserve the commercial relationship, we can escalate to a paid pilot with limited trial privileges.

-rishi
